items.title: takeone tool migration: done-done proof for checks + offline render
items.about: Static checks pass (floor guard, typecheck, full test suite) and the offline demo take plans with --no-jev and renders to a real 1920x1080 h264 MP4. The verify-takeone skill is deleted with no shim; CI gates on a done-done run+check job; learn-from-mistakes retro run 1 completed.

evidence.outcome: takeone static checks pass and the offline demo take plans and renders to a real MP4
evidence.proof: no verify skill - done-done run checks + done-done run offline-render
